rule: When a fix changes a value's null-ness (e.g. `x || default` -> an explicit null/undefined check), grep EVERY downstream consumer of that variable for unguarded use and add the guard in the SAME fix. If a consumer can't be guarded here, mark the fix 'skipped' rather than ship a crash.
why: The inlined schema-drift-apply / ux-fix agents edit TS (and sometimes run.py). A null-ness change at the assignment site silently breaks unguarded consumers downstream — the same defect class the MLX review lane hit (count or 1 -> None crash, iter-6).
source: seeded iter-10 (mirrors review-optimize fix-trace-consumers-on-nonecheck, scoped to the orchestrator's inlined fix agents)

rule: Do not broaden catch/finally to swallow errors silently. A missing dependency or environment error must stay LOUD (propagate, or log + degrade). Narrow catches to the specific error class.
why: except/catch over-reach is the #1 error-handling fix defect across both families; silent swallowing hides environment failures the operator must see (MLX iter-5 audio_noise_detect). Applies to any fix the inlined lanes apply to GUI server/runtime code.
source: seeded iter-10 (mirrors review-optimize fix-no-silent-error-swallow, scoped to the orchestrator's inlined fix agents)
